compared_quantities.bind: mode order, with the plane of each mode

comparison_conventions: For quantities with a nonzero named continuum prediction, relative deviation = (value − continuum) / |continuum|. This convention defines no comparison where that prediction is absent.

where a mode's two largest translational components are equal in magnitude, the shape's sign and the participation factor's sign are not compared; frequency, effective mass and combined magnitudes are

conditions: every extracted mode and the rigid frequency lie strictly inside the table (SWBPIPE refuses outside it; the other program uses the end value)

other_program_settings.note: the capture also takes every other mode sum and direction sum the program offers, as declared variants of this file; the comparable setting is the one stated here

spectra.ordinate_other_program: acceleration in mm/sec2 (multiply each ordinate by 1000)

family_description: one straight pipe along X, anchored at A, UZ held at the tip B: a cantilever in the XY plane and a propped cantilever in the XZ plane; no repeated mode
folded_from: folded into the seeded generator from the dynamics lane's wrapper files, dynamics family draft 4, 2026-11-12: the model members by the same arithmetic, byte for byte; the reference values quoted from tools/caepipe_correlation/dynamics_reference_quotes.json

inexact_input_sizes.mass_formulation: per member count and response kind in validation/references/f2_spectrum (closed_form/screening_basis.json and beams_fe.json; pull request 268, not yet on main)
inexact_input_sizes.shear_deformation: ESTIMATE, not a reference value: SWBPIPE has no shear deformation in dynamics; if the other program includes it, under 1e-3 relative on every compared frequency at this slenderness (about five times the Rayleigh rotary term)

mode_count_note: the counts differ between the sides where a diagonal mass formulation has fewer finite modes: at 1 member it has the Y bending mode and one axial mode (2) against 5 on the consistent side; at 2 members 5 (three bending, two axial) against the first 6
